thread:
Sam: Thanks all for joining the all-hands. Quick follow-up thread to capture the small clarifications folks asked for live and to list owners for the three asks that came up. I'll ping owners below — please confirm and add any missing context.

Priya: Q about Dedicated GA — what's the official launch quarter and will there be a public changelog?

Sam: Dedicated GA target is end of Q2. We'll publish a public changelog and a migration guide.

Jules: I'll own the migration guide. Planning doc link: https://internal.redwood/handbook/dedicated-ga (will update with stages).

Priya: Awesome. Also, can we clarify SLA tiers for Dedicated vs Hosted in the public docs? A few customers asked during the huddle.

Sam: Good call. SLA matrix is overhead for legal/product to finalize; product will push a summary by next Tuesday.

Ava: I'll draft the summary and post a PR to the docs repo. Owner: @Ava. ETA: Tue 09:00 PT.

Connor: Sales ask from live Q: will there be an upfront discount for 12-month reserved Dedicated commits? Need language for deals that are in flight.

Sam: Yes — standard reserved pricing applies. Finance is confirming exact discount bands; Connor, can you collect 2-3 example deal sizes and i'll loop in finance?

Connor: Yep — I'll DM a few examples and tag finance.

Jules: Ops question from infra audience: are there recommended quantization profiles for 8-bit configs? We hinted at optimizer flags in the demo but need a short config snippet.

Ava: Here's a short snippet we can add to the runtime docs:```yaml
model:
  quantize: true
  profile: 8bit-fast
  kernel: fused-attn
  batch_size_hint: 8
```

Jules: Perfect. Can you add that to the infra quickstart? Owner: @Jules + @Ava to confirm wording.

Sam: Noted. Next: quality/regression monitoring — we said we'd provide teams with a simple eval harness for rollout checks. Who's taking that?

Priya: Product will own the eval harness spec; research will ship the first test harness to the repo. Owner: @Priya, collaborator: @Jules. ETA: 2 weeks.

Connor: From GTM: can we get a short blurb that marketing can use for the Dedicated announcement? 2-3 lines.

Sam: I'll work with Marketing. @Connor please put a 2-sentence draft in this thread and I'll refine.

ops-bot: Reminder — follow-up survey posted: https://internal.redwood/surveys/ah-2149998765 — please fill in ownership confirmations by EOD Friday.

Priya: One quick clarification on routing policies — in the demo we showed fallback to cheaper model variants; is that opt-in per route or global?

Jules: It's route-level by default. We'll add a global config option in Dedicated for account-wide fallback policies. Owner: @Jules.

Ava: Small doc ask: add example curl snippet showing streaming + function-calling for the console docs. I'll drop that PR today.

Sam: Great. To make this easy to scan, here's the action list I captured — please react with :thumbsup: if correct and update if not.

- Dedicated migration guide: owner @Jules — ETA 2w — link to planning doc above.
- SLA summary and matrix: owner @Ava — ETA Tue 09:00 PT.
- Pricing bands confirmation for reserved commits: owner @Connor (sales) + Finance — ETA by next Thu.
- Quantization quickstart snippet in runtime docs: owners @Jules + @Ava — ETA 1w.
- Eval harness spec & initial tests: owner @Priya + Research — ETA 2w.
- Marketing announcement blurb: owner @Connor + Sam — draft by Mon.
- Global fallback config for Dedicated: owner @Jules — investigate feasibility, ETA 3w.

Priya: Looks accurate. Adding: can we get a short FAQ entry addressing "what happens to hosted customers during Dedicated GA"?

Sam: Yep — FAQ item added to the GA page. @Ava you'll add that to the docs PR.

Connor: Thx — I'll pull these into the deal enablement doc once PRs live.

Jules: One more infra follow-up: schedule a deep-dive working session for KV cache behavior under high-concurrency — volunteers? I can host Fri 10:00 PT.

Ava: I'll attend.

Priya: I'll join to align product acceptance criteria.

Sam: Great — please keep meeting notes in the planning doc.

Sam: If anyone has additional clarifications from the live Q&A that aren't captured, drop them here or ping me directly. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
